summary: Implemented the PH-325 read-only invoice pairing slice at BASE 20ffc12 (rebased; originally 863f946). New pmo_plugins/invoicing/invoice_reconciliation_services.py exposes invoice_pairing(member, *, invoice_id=None, project_id=None, as_of=None): it derives invoice header/line/allocation/reversal/tax-qualification facts together with the referenced settlement OpenItem/Clearance/Settlement snapshots (gross/cleared/remaining/due), management-revenue recognition/adjustment totals per project, and contract-line terms, returning allocated/unallocated totals, recognized revenue, tax-qualification facts, issue codes (source_missing, unsupported_source_kind, unallocated_amount, over_allocated, duplicate_pairing, revenue_invoice_mismatch, tax_unconfirmed, cross_org_source, invalid_source_ref) and missing[] entries where upstream data is absent (null plus code, never zero). Reads are role-scoped: owner/finance/auditor get the organization, pm only visible/managed projects (detail and project filters enforce this, member is denied), and the canonical GET route is bound as history_read through pmo_plugins/delivery/urls.py (no invoicing/urls.py). A read-only filter form and template render the snapshot; no writes, audit events, receipts, migrations or ledger facts are created. 18 new tests cover role boundaries, project scoping, settlement/contract/tax projections, unallocated and missing-source cases, duplicate pairing across invoices, org/project aggregation, zero-write behavior, HTTP 200/400/403 boundaries, history_read after disabling the module, and the review regressions: no-revenue null+missing, as_of-bounded future adjustments, per-project revenue comparison for multi-project invoices, and project-filter mismatch denial. Tax-qualification confirmation is deliberately not implemented in this read-only slice and is deferred to PH-320.

review.reviewer: independent PH-325 invoice reconciliation reviewer (fresh context, read-only)
findings: BLOCKER - missing revenue is reported as 0: `_revenue_for_project` returns a totals integer initialized to 0 even when there are no posted RevenueRecognition rows, and `_invoice_detail` only emits `revenue_missing` when `recognized is None` (never true). An invoice/ project without revenue facts therefore shows `recognized_net_cents=0` instead of null+missing, contrary to the task's null+missing requirement. Fix: detect no posted recognition rows and return None + revenue_missing (or equivalent), keeping 0 only for a real zero-valued posted fact.

BLOCKER - as_of is not applied to RevenueAdjustment: recognitions are filtered by occurred_on <= as_of, but `_revenue_for_project` sums every posted RevenueAdjustment for those recognitions regardless of its own occurred_on, so an as-of historical snapshot can include future adjustments and produce a false recognized total. Fix: bound adjustments by occurred_on/as-of consistently and add historical as-of regressions.

BLOCKER - multi-project invoices produce false revenue mismatches: `_invoice_detail` collects allocations across potentially several projects but sets `project_id = next(iter(projects))` (nondeterministic), then compares that single project's recognized revenue with the invoice's total net allocated across all projects. A valid invoice allocated to two projects will raise `revenue_invoice_mismatch` even when each project reconciles. Fix: aggregate recognized revenue per project and compare per-project allocation, or explicitly mark multi-project invoices as unsupported/missing rather than using the first project; make the result deterministic and test the multi-project case.

BLOCKER - the project filter is not enforced for invoice detail: `invoice_pairing(..., invoice_id=..., project_id=...)` validates the project then ignores it in the detail branch; any requested project passes even if the invoice's projects do not include it. The pm detail permission also checks only the first project from the nondeterministic set. Fix: require the invoice's project set to intersect/equal the requested project (and the pm-visible set) before returning detail, and test a mismatched project_id.

OTHER CONTENT CHECKED: read-only service imports only owner facts; no audit/receipt/migration/session writes; invoice/line/allocation/reversal, settlement open-item/clearance, contract-line and tax qualification projections are derived; issues for invalid/unsupported source, source_missing, cross_org_source, duplicate_pairing (same/cross invoice), unallocated/over_allocated, reversal_exceeds_invoice, tax_unconfirmed/tax_qualification_missing are present; pm list scope uses visible projects; member denied; canonical delivery/urls.py binding, no invoicing/urls.py; 13 files within the whitelist; no migration. Full suite 1175/5F+3E/69 known baseline; check 263; makemigrations clean; scoped 14 OK; fresh verify_integrity ok; verify-change only review/acceptance gates, no path_out_of_scope. TaxQualification confirmation write is honestly disclosed as PH-320 follow-up.

deviations: Review-blocker fix (old->new): (1) _revenue_for_project now returns None when no posted RevenueRecognition exists, so recognized revenue is null plus revenue_missing instead of 0; (2) RevenueAdjustment is bounded by its own occurred_on <= as_of; (3) multi-project invoices compare recognized revenue per project against that project's allocated net (recognized_by_project, deterministic project_ids) instead of comparing one arbitrary project to the total; (4) invoice detail now enforces the requested project_id and the pm visible-project set before returning, and the project list filter is unchanged. Four regression tests were added (18 scoped tests total); full suite 1179=5F+3E+69 with no new failure.
